ShopChecks.scope: Actual original-price shop quote/confirm/approved purchase-sale, explicit unknown sale quote, owned-item/currency and isolated persistence contracts; no recovered native opcode/sale formula claim.

MercenaryChecks.scope: Actual original-list mercenary hire/dismiss approval, explicit refund, ownership/currency and isolated persistence contracts; not battle deployment or recovered server policy.

RevivalChecks.scope: Actual temple quote/approval/persistence services with isolated explicit fees and health; no default resurrection economy or original wire protocol claim.

WarehouseChecks.scope: Actual warehouse terms/staged move/final approval, ownership conservation, fee and persistence contracts with isolated limits/prices; no original wire/order/capacity policy claim.
